licence.description: SPDX identifier where one applies, or a short name for bespoke terms.

attribution.description: The notice that must accompany any redistribution of this inventory.

regime_kind.description: requirement: the regime imposes obligations, so a mapping to it can evidence that something is already required. threat: the regime catalogues attacks and imposes no obligations, so a mapping to it establishes relevance only and can never be full strength.

reproduction.description: How much of the source this inventory contains. reference-only means identifiers and factual designations with no source-authored text; descriptive means short source-authored names are reproduced under a licence that permits it; authored means OpenAISF wrote the descriptors itself.
